//: What the kit installs but does not carry: each module is its own repo, pinned to a released version.
id: the component `ak setup` shows (`ak setup --only <id>`). A module either ships a Claude Code
plugin (plugin: its name, source: a marketplace source at the pinned tag; scripts/kit.py lists it in
kit/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) or is installed by its own script (install: the path in the repo,
fetched at tag v<version> through gh when logged in, else curl, and run as `sh <it> --version <version>`).
setup: what ak setup needs to know, the same block a plugin.json may carry (catalog.py says its keys).

modules.label: claude shim
modules.description: The claude on your PATH becomes a wrapper that runs your fragments and appends your system prompt.

setup.summary: the wrapper the claude you type goes through
gives: ak sysprompt — your own instructions, added to every claude you start
small scripts of yours that run before claude starts (its conf.d folder)
claude --account <name>, with the gateway — start on the account you name
setup.changes: the claude you type becomes a small wrapper, first on your PATH through one line in your shell's startup files; the real claude is untouched
setup.route: claude → shim → Claude Code → Anthropic, on Claude Code's own login

modules.label: gateway
modules.description: Routes every model call through one local service: accounts, redaction, a record of what was sent.

setup.summary: all your Claude accounts behind one claude
gives: claude --account <name> — start on the account you name
the next account answers when one runs out
ak gateway — your accounts, and what went through it
ak sysprompt — your own instructions on every claude
setup.changes: the claude you type becomes a small wrapper, the claude shim (the real one untouched) · a background service on 127.0.0.1:4747 that every model call goes through · you sign in to your Claude account once
setup.route: claude → shim → Claude Code → gateway → Anthropic, on your accounts in turn
